_readme: The host's script. Each event has lines grouped by rating; a room picks from every line at or below its
rating and favours the spiciest tier it's allowed, so MA and NC-17 rooms get the sassier material.
Every event needs at least one PG line. Placeholders in {braces} are filled in by the server; see
server/src/host.rs for which placeholders each event gets. Point HOST_SCRIPT at a copy to swap scripts
